overview.name: Complete Marine Services
overview.description: Rigoo Marine delivers end-to-end vessel care — from routine maintenance and mechanical repairs to full structural overhauls and cosmetic restorations, all under one roof in Qatar.

mechanical.name: Mechanical & Engine Services
mechanical.description: Engine diagnostics, repair, and overhauls. Oil changes, fuel system servicing, propeller and drive system repairs to keep your vessel running at peak performance.

structural.name: Structural Repair
structural.description: Hull repair, transom reinforcement, fiberglass lamination, and deck restoration. We restore structural integrity with precision and durability.

cosmetic.name: Cosmetic & Finishing
cosmetic.description: Gel coat polishing, anti-fouling bottom paint, teak refinishing, and exterior detailing. We bring back the shine and protect your investment.

renovation.name: Full Vessel Renovation
renovation.description: Complete interior and exterior renovations tailored to your vision — upholstery, electrical upgrades, custom carpentry, and full system refreshes.

specialized.name: Specialized Services
specialized.description: Survey preparations, warranty work, custom fabrication, and emergency repairs. Specialist expertise for demanding jobs that require advanced technical skills.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Rigoo Marine serves boat owners and marine businesses across Qatar with professional repair, maintenance, and restoration services.
story.p2: What started as a focused engine repair shop has grown into a full-service marine facility — from routine maintenance to complete vessel restorations.
story.p3: Our commitment to quality workmanship, transparent QAR pricing, and bilingual customer service has made us a trusted partner for marine work in the region.
